status: Mathematical/physical inverse-problem illustration only; not fit to any measurement and not proposed material Hamiltonian.
one_physical_orbital_Hamiltonian: H=Σ_kσ(ε_k−µ)n_kσ+U Σ_k n_k↑n_k↓. Interaction is local in momentum and infinite range in real space; all fermions are the physical one-orbital c.
state: T=0 spin-symmetric ensemble in singly occupied manifold: n_k↑=n_k↓=1/2, ν=1/2. Extensive spin degeneracy. NMR and transport have not been fitted; this is not proposed as a model of the samples.
momentum_relation: ε_minus(k)=ε_plus(k+Q), Q=(π,π). The local spectra are identical by relabeling momenta.
what_it_proves: A local spectral density and its frequency Kramers–Kronig transform do not identify the momentum assignment of G or the Γ-side zero area. This does not assert matching of NMR, transport, diffraction, or all other material constraints.
